description: This file provides PHP4 session management using the ADODB database wrapper library, including functions for session handling such as open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection, with configuration for database connection and session parameters.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID, updates the database record, and handles cookie updates.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Creates and opens a database connection for session management.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database for a given session key.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, updating expiry and handling CRC optimization.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes a session record from the database and triggers expiration notifications if configured.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by deleting expired sessions and optionally optimizing the table.
